entrypoints.summary: SafeTensors::deserialize accepts a whole safetensors byte buffer, reads metadata, and retains post-header bytes as tensor data.
The audit finding targets Metadata::validate in safetensors/src/tensor.rs and identifies tensor offsets as the reported validation subject.

code_slices.vulnerable: The historical vulnerable implementation is not supplied. The audit reports that Metadata::validate did not check tensor offsets against total tensor-data size.

impact.affected_asset: Availability of a process that deserializes and materializes tensor views from the supplied file.
impact.attacker_capability: Provide a serialized safetensors input whose declared offsets are structurally arranged but do not correspond to available tensor data.
impact.security_effect: Denial of service through an out-of-bounds, metadata-derived tensor-data slice/panic path.

causal_trace.summary: A supplied safetensors file carries metadata declaring tensor data offsets.

TOB-SFTN-1 reports that Metadata::validate did not check tensor offsets against the total tensor-data size; consequently, relative metadata validation did not establish correspondence to the actual data section.
The tensor-view path forms a Rust range slice of the retained data buffer using metadata-derived start and end offsets.
An offset range accepted despite extending beyond available tensor data can reach a bounds-sensitive slice operation and cause an availability failure; no execution transcript is supplied.

failure.operation: Range slicing of the deserialized tensor-data buffer with metadata data_offsets.

primary_invariant.statement: Every declared tensor byte range must be valid for the serialized tensor-data section, and the declared tensor ranges must end exactly at that section's end.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The audit finding identifies a historical Metadata::validate check that did not compare declared offsets with total tensor-data size, allowing structural offset checks without physical-buffer coverage.

quality.review_notes: The public audit excerpt identifies TOB-SFTN-1, Metadata::validate, and the missing total-data-size offset check, but the supplied report extraction is truncated before its full scenario and client response. The inspected Rust file is later source: it demonstrates the direct metadata-derived slice and current MetadataIncompleteBuffer gate, but is not standalone proof of the audited vulnerable revision. No historical fixing diff, issue-specific malformed fixture, test result, or crash transcript is present.

remediation.invariant_restored: The inspected later implementation computes the metadata end offset and rejects the file with MetadataIncompleteBuffer unless that end, plus header framing, equals the full serialized buffer length.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: Supply a safetensors byte buffer whose metadata declares a tensor offset range not backed by the post-header data section.
data_structure_invariants: Tensor ranges are consecutive from offset zero.
Each tensor range length matches its shape and dtype size.
The aggregate declared range end must match the physical serialized data-section end.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: Offsets originate in serialized metadata; the inspected validator rejects nonconsecutive ranges, reversed ranges, size mismatches, arithmetic overflow, and—at the later read_metadata gate—aggregate mismatch with the physical buffer length.
numeric_domains.name: tensor data offsets
numeric_domains.width: usize in the inspected Rust validator
